description: This file implements file-based BIO (Basic Input/Output) operations for OpenSSL, including functions for opening, reading, writing, seeking, and closing files, with platform-specific handling and support for large files.

methods.name: BIO_new_file
methods.description: Creates a new BIO object associated with a file specified by filename and mode, with platform-specific handling for opening files.

methods.name: BIO_new_fp
methods.description: Creates a new BIO object from an existing FILE pointer.

methods.name: BIO_s_file
methods.description: Returns the BIO_METHOD structure for file BIOs.

methods.name: file_new
methods.description: Initializes a new BIO object for file operations.

methods.name: file_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a BIO object.

methods.name: file_read
methods.description: Reads data from the file BIO.

methods.name: file_write
methods.description: Writes data to the file BIO.

methods.name: file_ctrl
methods.description: Performs control operations like seek, tell, flush, and mode setting on the file BIO.

methods.name: file_gets
methods.description: Reads a line from the file BIO.

methods.name: file_puts
methods.description: Writes a string to the file BIO.
